name: Replacement_Request
_about: Spec v1.4 Exceptions and Replacement (02 / 06). Target_Delivery is set at creation (RR-R3); the rest are server-written: a widget write is dropped.

fields.name: Target_Delivery
fields.label: Target Delivery
fields.helpText: RR-R3: the original target if it is still ahead, else today + rr_default_days.

fields.name: Order_Date
fields.label: Original Order Date
fields.helpText: The original SO's Order Date (RR-R3). Server-written.

fields.name: Original_Supplier
fields.label: Original Supplier
fields.helpText: RR-R1: who supplied the item first. RR_Supplier is the supplier chosen for the replacement.

fields.name: Supplier_Change_Reason
fields.label: Supplier Change Reason
fields.helpText: RR-R1: required when the supplier was changed.

fields.name: Rr_Category
fields.label: Category
fields.helpText: Open replacements are Broken: first in every queue (RR-R4). Server-written.

fields.name: Rr_Queue_Rank
fields.label: Queue Rank
fields.helpText: Oldest original Order Date first. Server-written.
